context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 74 tested new share modal feature with 6 sharing options (Copy Link, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Print, Save QR). Share modal accessed via Share2 icon in registration table Actions column. Backend POST /api/guest-journey/share-link/{registration_id} endpoint supports email/sms/whatsapp channels. SMS requires Twilio config in channel_settings, WhatsApp requires valid Facebook OAuth token. Email uses Resend (placeholder key). Registration detail drawer also has Share Options and Print buttons. Public pages: /register/{token} and /feedback/{token} working correctly.

mocked_apis.note: SMS (Twilio) and WhatsApp require API keys configured in channel_settings - they return 'skipped' or 'failed' status without valid config. Email uses Resend placeholder key (re_123456789).
